title: potentilla apennina subsp. deorum
intro: Potentilla apennina subsp. deorum, commonly known as the Dei Potentilla, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is primarily known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Potentilla apennina subsp. deorum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, reduce oxidative stress, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
